verdicts.rationale: C4 ships effects:[] with the curator note explicitly flagging the choice ('Flag-and-ask on whether to approximate with per-class *FlatDmg buffs'). Implement-first resolves it: Pathfinder's Blessing (+70% of the caster's ATK as flat DMG to a recipient's N/CA/Plunge/E/Q) is expressible with wired primitives — the per-class *FlatDmg stats plus a scaling-on-ATK BuffValue, exactly the shape shipped and rendering today on Escoffier C2 and Yun Jin's burst. It is a genuine team offensive buff (a buff window, not a damage tick or a FROZEN reaction), so it is not constitution-excluded; flat-DMG buffs are an authored, in-scope category. Not a caveat-only gap. The un-modelable residuals (8-instance pool = maxProcs; per-hit consumption = consumeStacks on onHit) are covered by a short residual caveat, mirroring Yun Jin's 30-trigger-quota precedent. [Adjudicated: executed 2026-07-20 — normalFlatDmg single-class authoring on the C4 entry; verifier prose correction applied (sibling C2 is +300 flat ATK).]
verdicts.implementSpec: Author Pathfinder's Blessing on the C4 entry as flat-DMG team buff effect(s), the same shape as Escoffier C2 (fresh_fragrant_stew) and Yun Jin's burst — both wired and rendering today. Per attack class add a buff effect: stat normalFlatDmg (plus chargeFlatDmg / plungeFlatDmg / skillFlatDmg / burstFlatDmg to cover all five classes the description lists), target 'active' (mirroring A1's Guidance-of-Theosis ATK buff and Escoffier's 'target: active is the closest schema fit'), trigger onCast ability:skill (mirroring the sibling Guidance-gated C2 +300 flat ATK and C6 DEF-ignore effects, which model the Guidance window optimistically for 20s), duration 20, durationType fixed, snapshottable false, value { type:'scaling', stat:'atk', ratio:70 } (70% of the caster's ATK, no cap — gcsim adds 0.7*Nicole.TotalAtk). Per Escoffier's legibility note the reviewer may author only a subset of classes (e.g. normalFlatDmg) rather than all five to keep the team-buff row readable, and confirms active-vs-team scope.
verdicts.residualCaveat: Not modeled: it drops after 8 hits (one instance per opponent struck), so the shown window may run longer than the real one.
rubricRefs: Implement-first doctrine (author wired primitives instead of a caveat for a wireable gap)
CAN model: Buff windows — scaling BuffValue, cross-character caster-stat scaling
CANNOT model: no maxProcs / per-window proc caps (8-instance pool)
CANNOT model: consumeStacks on onHit (per-hit consumption)

groundedIn.claim: Buff value is 70% of the caster's (Nicole's) ATK as flat DMG, with no cap.
groundedIn.quote: gcsim cons.go c4Init: FlatDmg += 0.7*Nicole.TotalAtk, Tags[c4Key]=8, c4Key 20*60, c4ICDKey 16*60.

groundedIn.claim: The flat-DMG add applies across five attack classes (N/CA/Plunge/E/Q) at 70% of Nicole's ATK, for 20s, and re-triggers once per 16s per character.
groundedIn.quote:
When nearby party members have their **Grace of Kenosis** upgraded to **Guidance of Theosis**, Nicole also bestows upon them the Pathfinder's Blessing effect for 20s. Each character can gain this effect once every 16s.
The Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, and Elemental Burst DMG of characters with Pathfinder's Blessing is increased by 70% of Nicole's ATK.

groundedIn.claim: The residual un-modelable part is the 8-instance consumable pool, consumed one per opponent struck (the divergence the residual caveat repairs).
groundedIn.quote:
This effect will be removed once it has taken effect 8 times or when its duration is over.
When multiple opponents are hit at once, instances of Pathfinder's Blessing are consumed equal to the number of opponents hit. Each character's Pathfinder's Blessing is counted independently.

groundedIn.claim: The curator note itself frames this as a flag-and-ask on approximating with per-class FlatDmg buffs, which implement-first resolves in favor of authoring.
groundedIn.quote: Not modeled: the flat-DMG add applies across all five attack classes from a single shared 8-instance consumable pool — no single stat expresses this, and the per-hit consumption/16s-per-char gating is beyond the buff model. Flag-and-ask on whether to approximate with per-class *FlatDmg buffs.

groundedIn.claim: Precedent proves per-class FlatDmg scaling on ATK is wired and rendering, target 'active' is the accepted fit, and the reviewer may author a subset of classes for legibility.
groundedIn.quote: Authored only on normalFlatDmg to keep the team-buff row legible. Other stats (charge/plunge/skill/burstFlatDmg) would each render as a separate bar — verbose for a constellation effect. If team builder/comparison surfaces a need to model all 5, replicate the effect.

groundedIn.claim: Target 'active' is the established schema fit for this class of flat-DMG buff (Escoffier precedent).
groundedIn.quote: target: active is the closest schema fit.
